authorization: 用户要求继续本地感知到命题模块；不逐微步骤询问。
short_plan: 先用现有checkpoint在原C与新增C开发集联合选模、校准，隔离上轮选模混杂。
根据开发证据最多做两项轻量单因素对照，不访问D或已看过test进行选择。
若某方法至少2/3种子同时满足开发标准，固定合格模型后采12独立D根作一次验收；否则报告小规模对照定位的瓶颈。

selection.tune: old C tune180/12roots + new C dev37/6roots; equal domain,predicate,root,class weighting for BCE tie-break
selection.calibration: old C calibration120/8roots + same new C dev37/6roots; reused new dev acknowledged, no confidence-guarantee claim
selection.rank: Minimize number of failed domain/predicate raw gates, then sum excess over gates, then joint root/class macro BCE; earliest checkpoint breaks ties
selection.raw_gates: For EACH old/new domain and EACH held,in,open: raw0.5 FPR <=1%, positive recall >=95% where positives exist. A no-positive set cannot establish recall.
selection.thresholds: Symmetric grid .5,.6,.7,.8,.85,.9,.95,.975,.99,.995. Each domain coverage>=95%, known error<=2%, known FP/all negatives<=1%, known TP/all positives>=95%; choose maximum worst-domain coverage then lower threshold. No eligible threshold means failure, not all-UNKNOWN success.
selection.existing_pool: Each seed: original1500, prior-new selected, prior-new final1500 only; unavailable intermediate weights not reconstructed.
selection.family_acceptance: At least2/3 independently trained seeds pass tune and calibration raw gates plus threshold constraints. Freeze all qualifying seeds; evaluate all seeds for transparency, never choose by acceptance outcome.

training.data: old900 plus supplementary73, natural shuffled window ratio900:73; no new training roots
training.candidate_1: If joint development exposes unsupported in drift, change only supplementary target-in mask from0 to1 after read-only label/contact audit; all other training masks/loss/architecture unchanged.
training.candidate_2: If candidate1 fails, change only loss aggregation to equal held/in/open groups and inverse-frequency positive/negative weighting within each group, weights computed solely from training labels. Same candidate1 masks and architecture. No grid search.

independent_acceptance.factorial: 3 target colours x2 initial drawer states x2 new layouts =12roots
independent_acceptance.collection: unchanged lift and fixed empty-gripper probe on all12roots; unchanged lift then place_in_drawer on6open roots for positive in. At most30trajectories.
independent_acceptance.layout_exclusion: Before execution exclude prior same-environment layouts; all3positions within20mm or within30mm with close yaw count as too close; log rejected candidates.
independent_acceptance.gate: Report all counts/roots/gaps. Raw held/in/open FPR<=1% and positive recall>=95%, coverage>=95%, effective known positive recall>=95% where positives exist. Require planned12held-positive roots and6in-positive roots for full narrow-scope acceptance; collection misses remain misses/insufficient evidence, not resampled.
independent_acceptance.one_shot: Freeze candidates, thresholds, roots and collector before new acceptance inference. No acceptance-driven correction.
independent_acceptance.scope: Known RGB colours and native D environment, not novel object categories or LTL performance.
